import requests

def fetch_subscribers():
    subscribers = []
    next_url = "https://api.buttondown.com/v1/subscribers"

    while next_url:
        # Note that authentication is not handled in this code snippet,
        # for clarity's sake!
        response = requests.get(next_url)
        data = response.json()

        subscribers.extend(data["results"])
        next_url = data["next"]

    return subscribers

require 'net/http'
require 'json'

def fetch_subscribers
  subscribers = []
  next_url = "https://api.buttondown.com/v1/subscribers"

  while next_url
    # Note that authentication is not handled in this code snippet,
    # for clarity's sake!
    response = Net::HTTP.get(URI(next_url))
    data = JSON.parse(response)

    subscribers.concat(data["results"])
    next_url = data["next"]
  end

  subscribers
